FILEPATH.description: Current Project File Path (FILEPATH). Returns the full file path of the currently opened document/project. The request carries no meaningful body (DTO_EMPTY). The response is a flattened object { "FILE_PATH": <string> }; FILE_PATH is an empty string ("") when the project is a new, unsaved document.

Argument.description: Empty request body (DTO_EMPTY); no input fields are consumed by the handler.
